tasks.label: Build Release no-join-order-flag
tasks.command: TMPDIR=/mnt/local_ssd/tmp GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' make release -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Build Debug no-join-order-flag
tasks.command: TMPDIR=/mnt/local_ssd/tmp GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' make debug -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Generate Debug SQL (Case 3, JOB 4c)
tasks.command: { grep '^SET ' scripts/measure/settings-common.sql || true; grep '^SET ' scripts/measure/settings-run_job.sql || true; echo 'SET rpt_forward_only = true;'; cat join-order-benchmark/queries/4c.sql; } > scripts/debug/debug_query.sql

tasks.label: Generate Debug SQL (Case 4, JOB 4c)
tasks.command: { grep '^SET ' scripts/measure/settings-common.sql || true; grep '^SET ' scripts/measure/settings-run_job.sql || true; echo 'SET disable_tiered_hash_cache = true;'; cat join-order-benchmark/queries/4c.sql; } > scripts/debug/debug_query.sql

tasks.label: Build Debug ExactLeftDeep
tasks.command: TMPDIR=/mnt/local_ssd/tmp GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' make debug -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Build Release ExactLeftDeep
tasks.command: TMPDIR=/mnt/local_ssd/tmp GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' make release -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Build Release ExactLeftDeep (with thc timers)
tasks.command: TMPDIR=/mnt/local_ssd/tmp GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' CXXFLAGS='-DDUCKDB_ENABLE_HASH_JOIN_TIMERS=1' make release -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: RS on ASH-datagen Case 3
tasks.command: cd /mnt/local_ssd/spy; TMPDIR=/mnt/local_ssd/tmp GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' make release -j $(nproc); ./scripts/measure/run_ash_datagen_release.sh --case 3 rs

tasks.label: time RS on ASH-datagen Case 3
tasks.command: cd /mnt/local_ssd/spy; TMPDIR=/mnt/local_ssd/tmp GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' CXXFLAGS='-DDUCKDB_ENABLE_HASH_JOIN_TIMERS=1' make release -j $(nproc); ./scripts/measure/run_ash_datagen_release.sh --case 3 rs
